title: Final Pressure Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final expression for pressure as a function of position on the plane.

title: Image Charge Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly describe the image charge method and its application to the problem.

title: Distance Calculations
description: Important Criteria: The student must accurately calculate the distances r and r' from the point on the plane to the sphere's center and the image charge.

title: Area Element Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the differential area element on the image sphere correctly.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the expressions for charge densities and forces.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Use of Constants
description: Optional Criteria: The student should correctly identify and utilize constants such as epsilon_0 in their calculations.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases or special scenarios to validate their final expression.
